completion_policy: Completed 2026-09-24: the unmodified upstream Foundry suite of this repository passes against the Fe contracts with outcomes identical to the Solidity originals (tests/run_upstream_suites.py; tests/results/upstream-conformance-o1.json). Per-source evidence below remains the detailed record; contract size (EIP-170) is outside the completion scope.

sources.notes: All six endpoints, constructor configuration and error boundaries pass 30000 O1 fuzz cases plus five scenarios. Real Permit2 mint/increase/decrease/burn metadata passes 1000 fuzz cases across Solidity/Solidity, Fe/Solidity and Fe/Fe PositionManager/PoolManager combinations; complete URI bytes match the unmodified Solidity Descriptor. Protocol ABI verified. Final protocol-wide audit remains open. Compiler 702686c98 revalidation passes 30000 descriptor cases and 1000 complete metadata lifecycles with a rebuilt pinned Solidity oracle.

Current-master O1 passes lifecycle, credit/native actions, guards and real Permit2 plus Descriptor workflows across three implementation combinations. Lazy Multicall error precedence remains fixed; explicit fallback-receive and lazy-multicall ABI export adapters remain required. Final protocol-wide invariants remain open. Shared PositionPolicy extension passes 20000 O1 fuzz cases plus three fixed scenarios and ABI audit on compiler 31e5b965e; optional descriptor case skipped in this regression. Latest compiler 702686c98 passes shared-policy regression and real Descriptor lifecycle integration without skipped tests.

Latest-master O1: all nine methods, constructor overflow, salt authorization and packed storage, strict score updates and events, deadline/error precedence, real CREATE2 deployment/collision, prefunded addresses, failed constructors and empty runtime. 40000 fuzz cases plus three boundary scenarios. Public ABI verified.

Latest O1 workflow uses original pinned Permit2, real pools, and three router/manager combinations. 40000 fuzz cases plus four fixed tests cover single/multihop, settlement, insufficient/expired allowances, exact allowance debit, rollback, callback authentication and token-driven reentrancy. Concrete wrapper protocol ABI verified.

The concrete execute wrapper policy and public ABI are compared with an equivalent Solidity subclass. Final protocol-wide audit remains open.
